reviews.title: Was amazing - Now pay to play
reviews.text:
1st 2 levels are free, then u either 
1. Spend 5 bucks to get a couple more levels 
2. Watch the equivalent of 12 or so 2 minute long ads to unlock ONE level or
3. Log in every day for half a month straight for login rewards to unlock ONE level.

Just let us earn money via playing levels, idc if it’s repetitive, at least something. Dumb devs or dumb execs, u decide.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: I used to play this game back when I was 10 years old, I’m 23 now. Just came back to the game, seen a LOT of changes. My main and only gripe with the new changes is that everything has become “blocked behind a paywall” instead of reaching a milestone to unlock levels. Also literally having to pay to play the levels has taken away a lot of the enthusiasm I had to play the game. Please, this needs to be changed. Bring back to old version, the trailer before launching the game, the simple but direct goals.
